mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair loratadine metabolism and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk, particularly QT prolongation.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac status closely; consider alternative antihistamine if severe renal impairment develops; maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels.
